KeybindingsSpec.description:
One action binding value in config.

This accepts either:

1. A single key or chord string (`"ctrl-a"` or `"ctrl-x ctrl-s"`). 2. A list of alternative bindings (`["ctrl-a", "ctrl-x ctrl-s"]`).

An empty list explicitly unbinds the action in that scope. Because an explicit empty list is still a configured value, runtime resolution must not fall through to global or built-in defaults for that action.

chatbox_placeholder_tips.description:
Controls whether the chatbox placeholder shows a rotating set of tip prompts.

- `on` (default): Show rotating placeholder tips. - `off`: Use a generic placeholder instead.

file_mentions_allow_explicit_paths.description: Let `@` file search resolve absolute paths and paths beginning with `./` or `../`. Defaults to `true`.

file_mentions_preserve_at.description: Keep the leading `@` when a file-search completion is inserted into the composer. Defaults to `false`.

open_external_editor_with_quote.description: Open the external editor with the last agent response quoted below the current draft.

primary_accent.description:
Overrides the default cyan accent used throughout the TUI.

Supported formats: - `r,g,b` where each channel is `0..255` (for example `0,170,255`) - `#RRGGBB` (for example `#00AAFF`) - `0..255` ANSI palette index (for example `14`)
